response.text:
The new shipping notice fits best as an announcement on the homepage, placed right after the hero. The client gave us the facts (shipping across Slovenia, free over 75 €), so they can go into the copy. The announcement card has no price field, so the amount goes in the text. The link points to the gift page.

The hero is at index 0 and the contact-strip at index 1, so inserting at /pages/0/sections/1 puts the notice between them. The strip should stay near the top, though, so I put the announcement after the strip, at index 2. A bar variant is slim and suits a short notice.

The client wrote in English, but the site is in Slovene, so the copy is Slovene and the reply goes in Slovene as well.
